What degraded

  • the panel held twice before this email was built
    round 1 at 6.508 with four hard fails, every one a measurement, and round 2 at 6.192 with one hard fail all three judges named, which was round 1's own repair on frame 9. Both are repaired and round 3's result is what score.json carries. The run record has the whole account
  • the branch's ask_pack rungs did not survive the merge
    the owner's own fix landed on main as #288 while this deck was being built, the merge conflicted on the file, and main's version was taken whole. Two mechanisms for one ceiling would be two homes for one number

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The machine is in a money class, and the announcement never said so, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

The State Board of Education adopted a money class to match House Bill 27.

The text the board carried to final adoption asks a student to appraise robot-advisors by fee structure and algorithmic limitation. Students research careers using artificial intelligence tools. They explain how algorithm-driven recommendations shape spending.

The statute calls the half credit a curriculum requirement. There is no AI unit. The attachment still heads itself Text of Proposed New and the Register filing is unchecked against it.

The board's news release sums the standards up in eighteen words. None of them is artificial, algorithm or automated.

The item is dated September 4th. The motion asked for an effective date 20 days after filing. Which districts have a teacher ready to grade that appraisal in the 2027 to 2028 school year?

#SBOE #HB27 #TexasTEKS

2. The first comment

Every date above is the date this run FETCHED the document. The item prints its own date line, September 4th.

The term counts are computed from the fetched documents, never typed. The release was read as bytes with navigation and footer included and returned zero for artificial, algorithm, automated, machine learning, the token AI and the stem technolog. Whether that absence was deliberate is not knowable from these sources and the record does not guess.

Full item and every claim at texasaidocket.com

The machine changed itself

  • NOTHING WAS CHANGED IN THE MACHINE THIS RUN
    The retro phase runs after a finished deck and there was none. Three proposals are written into the run record instead, and none of them was made.
  • PROPOSAL. prompts/NEXT_RUN.md is unreachable by the routine that is told to write it
    Phase 0 step 4 says to read a story queued by the previous run from that path, and ownership.yaml puts it in human lane. This is the shape CLAUDE.md names as never fixable by rewording. Either the path moves to daily or Phase 0 stops naming it. The handoff went to the run record instead.
  • PROPOSAL. captions.json holds the newest entry out of its own exclusion window
    Both opening_moves_recent and closing_moves_recent derive from entries BEFORE the newest date, which is correct only on the day the newest entry is unshipped. Today that briefed a caption director with two moves that shipped on September 10th, and the candidate built on them was disqualified for it. The caption critic caught it and called it the third recurrence.
  • PROPOSAL. Four agent definitions have no write tool while the routine asks them for files
    carousel-scout, carousel-fact-checker, carousel-treatment-director and carousel-caption-director all returned their deliverables inline and the showrunner transcribed every one. Ten agents this run each spent part of a reply explaining they could not write the file they were asked for.

Each reverts on its own commit.

Notes

THE RECORD SHIPPED IN FULL. All 12 due items cleared, nothing rotten, nothing deferred, backlog zero at wake and zero at ship. THE ONE REAL CORRECTION. The Bureau of Labor Statistics comment window on adding artificial intelligence questions to the American Time Use Survey CLOSED on September 8th. The record still carried it as open, under a title reading "Federal comment window open", with an access note telling a reader they could still file. Status is now pending, the title and the access note say what a reader can actually do, and llms.txt stopped listing it under "Open right now" on this run's own build. Nine items came back unchanged and were stamped, and their movement lines were rewritten in the record's own words rather than left on the deterministic floor. Three the diff could not settle were worked by hand: Austin's parks resolution and the Avride opening resume are both PDFs, and all six and all sixteen quoted lines verify against bytes fetched this run. ADMITTED, FOUR. The State Board of Education's new financial literacy course, ERCOT's Batch Zero verification questionnaires, the energy department's bulk power system window closing October 9th, and the telecommunications agency asking whether its household survey should measure AI use, closing November 9th. HELD, ONE. Wiwynn's Socorro expansion, at medium confidence. Its release carries no publication date on the page, confirmed by two fetches, and does not name the county. NOTHING PROMPTED. prompt_audit measured 617 tool calls and none waited on a human. TWO GATES WENT RED ON THIS RUN'S OWN WORK AND BOTH WERE FIXED RATHER THAN WAIVED. schema_check caught that moving the ATUS abstract claim to the Federal Register API left the item's access url cited by no claim. house_style_check caught fourteen sentences of this run's own prose over the thirty word backstop, across five items.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
